subject: Re: Fjord Systems pilot — request for invoice-only / no-PO onboarding
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@fjordsys.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@fjordsys.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fjord pilot — request for invoice-only / no-PO onboarding

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Fjord is excited to start the 6-week integration pilot. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can onboard Fjord on an invoice-only path (no PO) for the pilot period.

Background: this is a time-limited pilot (6 weeks) with expected spend ~ $3k–$4k total, single product integration, and Fjord will provide standard security evidence (SOC 2 summary) and a completed vendor questionnaire. Our legal team is comfortable with Redwood’s T&Cs for pilots.

Ask: can you confirm an exception path so accounting can pay by invoice (Net30) without a formal PO for this specific pilot? If needed, we can provide an internal purchase memo from Fjord’s engineering lead.

Attached: completed vendor questionnaire (stub) and draft pilot statement-of-work (attachment: fjord_vendor_questionnaire.pdf).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can schedule the kickoff next week.

Best,
Sara Li
Head of Platform Partnerships
Fjord Systems

---
Attachment: fjord_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@fjordsys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fjord pilot — request for invoice-only / no-PO onboarding

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire. Glad the demo went well.

Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only path for small pilots, subject to a few conditions (risk evidence, spend cap, limited duration). I need to confirm approvals internally and will route to finance + procurement for sign-off.

Next steps / what I need from you:
- Confirm expected pilot total spend (best estimate is fine).
- Confirm the business owner at Fjord (name + email) who will sign the internal memo.
- If you can, send the SOC 2 summary and any additional security artifacts.

I’m attaching our onboarding form — please complete the red fields and return. Once I have that and your spend estimate I’ll escalate for a limited waiver.

Tentative: we typically allow invoice-only pilots up to $5k/month with a 90-day maximum duration if risk is low and Finance approves. I’ll confirm.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

---

Subject: Fwd: Fjord pilot — invoice-only request (quick approval ask)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Fjord's request. Quick summary below and my recommendation.

Summary:
- Account: Fjord Systems (platform partner)
- Pilot: 6 weeks, estimated $3k–$4k total
- Evidence provided: vendor questionnaire (partial), legal ok with standard T&Cs, SOC 2 summary inbound

My ask:
- Can Finance approve a temporary no-PO, invoice-only path limited to $5k/month (max 90 days) with requirement for signed waiver + completed risk scorecard?

Why: small predictable spend, partner signal, quicker time-to-first-integration. Mitigations: require signed waiver, Net30 terms, require SOC2 summary and completion of vendor_risk_scorecard. If risk score > threshold we revert to standard PO onboarding.

Karthik — any concerns operationally for provisioning or billing if we do invoice-only for this partner?

Thanks,
Priya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Fjord pilot — invoice-only request (quick approval ask)

Priya / Marissa — I’m fine with a temporary invoice-only exception for small pilots with controls. Two operational notes:
- Billing: our finance tooling can accept invoice-only vendors; we need a Vendor ID created with "invoice-only" flag and a max monthly cap entered so AP routes flagged invoices for expedited approval.
- Provisioning: engineering can spin up a sandbox account once we have the waiver signed and the onboarding form completed.

I ran the preliminary vendor_risk_scorecard (attached) — Fjord looks low-risk on key items (no high-risk third parties, standard data handling). Recommend approval with the conditions Priya listed: cap $5k/month, 90-day max, Net30, signed waiver on file, and review at the end of pilot.

If Finance signs off I’ll trigger the sandbox provisioning and create the Vendor ID.

-Karthik
